title: runic.translations.interchange-review/2
description: Review state of translations: the optional <catalog>.review.json beside runic.json that runic-translations review mark and xliff import write, the review export of the Translations Editor, and the review data of TranslationInterchange.ExportReviewJson. Each entry records the per-unit source fingerprint of the source its translation was made or approved for; validate warns (RTR0090) when the current source differs. Readers also accept runic.translations.interchange-review/1, whose approval fingerprints covered the whole catalog.

entries.description: Sorted by key, then locale; at most one entry per key and locale.

locale.description: A translated locale of the catalog.

state.description: XLIFF initial, translated, translated with subState runic:needs-review, and final.

sourceFingerprint.description: sha256: and the per-unit fingerprint of the key, the source text and the caller contract the translation was made or approved for.
